title: Authorized Visits Not Yet Drawn on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
On an Insured Plan of Care, approved visits of the current authorization not yet drawn are carried into the coming period by the payer and are not asked for again in an extension request.

| Current authorization | Visits not yet drawn |
|---|---|
| In force on today's date | Its approved visits less the visits drawn on it |
| Its span has not started yet | All of its approved visits |
| Otherwise (its span has ended) | None |

The visits not yet drawn that remain once any of them still to be drawn before the authorization ends are taken off are the visits carried into the period; the visits carried are never below zero, and the visits asked for, less the visits carried, are never below zero.

## Hypothetical cases (today 2026-05-05)

- Authorization 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-20, 12 approved, 9 drawn: 3 not yet drawn.
- Authorization 2026-05-10 to 2026-06-30, 10 approved: its span has not started, so all 10 are not yet drawn.
- Authorization 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-30, 12 approved, 8 drawn: none, the span having ended.
- An extension count of 18 with 3 visits not yet drawn and none of them still to be drawn: 15 visits are asked for.
